Lore="On Earth-928B in 2099, Miguel O'Hara is the superhero "Spider-Man", a human mutate with retractable talons, fangs, and enhanced strength that he used to fight crime in his home of Nueva York, along with a spider-inspired costume and laser web shooters. He works closely with his A.I. assistant LYLA, who develops many of his gadgets and weaponry for his work as Spider-Man.During an experiment, his coworker messed with the machine and O'Hara's DNA became 50 percent spider. In story lines that unfolded in the years to come, the newly-minted superhero teamed up with Peter Parker to fight against Alchemax and some of the comic's most notorious villains, including the Green Goblin. Desperate to protect the multiverse, Miguel decided to create the Spider Society, a group of spider-like heroes from across the multiverse dedicated to eradicating anomalies and returning displaced individuals to their original universes.
